stories.title: CPSC Recalls Blossom Children's Loungewear — Burn Hazard, Sizes 12M–12Y

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
CPSC recall: Blossom children's loungewear — burn hazard.

Violates federal flammability standard. Sizes 12M to 12Y.

Stop use. Destroy. Email sales@blossomocc.com for a refund. Details at cpsc.gov/Recalls.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

stories.title: CDC Data: Teen Mental Health Is Improving — But Gaps Remain for Girls and LGBTQ Youth

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
New CDC data: teen sadness fell to 33% in 2025 — down from 42% in 2021.

Girls and LGBTQ youth still face much higher rates.

Worth a conversation with your teens. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

article.headline: CDC: Teen Mental Health Is Improving — But Colorado Springs Parents Should Still Pay Attention
